stem: A nutrient batch is mixed to the correct volume and EC but pH remains outside the supplied acceptance range. What should the technician do?
choices: Release the batch because EC is correct
Follow the approved pH-adjustment or hold/escalation procedure and document the final verified condition
Ignore pH if the plants look healthy
Add concentrated acid or base without measuring
rationale: Meeting one specification does not override another. The batch should meet the supplied acceptance criteria using the approved adjustment procedure.
